$comment: The visit summary the doctor sends from their own WhatsApp (docs/plans/visit-story-design.md, C2; fuller text in docs/plans/visit-story-v2-offers-design.md, section 1.2). Placeholders in braces are filled by aarogyam_domain::visit_message. 'short' is the version for hand-offs that travel in a web URL: it must carry no clinical words and no patient name. Every line states a recorded fact; the wording of the new lines is reviewed by: pending (founder). English in v1; Hindi and Marathi follow after review by a native-speaking dentist.
